what: the first recording of the golden cases with the baseline configuration, kept because it exposed two faults
found: the assertion 'look before a motion' accepted only get_robot_state as a look, while the executor counts any tool result that reports state_seq (check_named_target, the previous motion's own result); cases 02 and 08 failed although every motion was based on the current state

case 07 (run the rig check): the model returned neither text nor a tool call, and the loop accepted the empty reply as a final answer. Sent back to the model, the reply stayed empty; asked directly, the model server returned 16 generated tokens and nothing it could parse, and the same request with the model's reasoning switched on gave a well-formed call of run_runbook
changed: the assertion now follows the executor's rule: a motion must be based on the state number the latest tool result reported

an empty reply to a turn that offers tools is asked for again once with the model's reasoning switched on (the reasoning text is not used), and an empty reply that still reaches the loop is sent back instead of being accepted
